question: Is there another way to prototype AI agents on your own machine that combines what the Brainstem's one-file agent gives: one file, live on the next message, a chat built in, no keys, the same file portable and runnable anywhere Python runs, deterministic output that can be re-run and checked, and rapp/1 same-bytes-everywhere identity?
rule: Today the Brainstem is the one package that meets every criterion. It stays until someone else builds the same thing: an alternative must meet every criterion, not most. Checked monthly; each check appends one entry. Bring a match to Kody; never retire the Brainstem on a check alone.

checks.by: Claude (session review, not a full market survey)

candidates.note: Cloud only; each change needs import and publish.
Prose the model follows again each run.
Closest; a server plus host setup, no chat of its own.

checks.verdict: No alternative meets all criteria. The Brainstem stays.

criteria_notes.local_answer_key_for_deploy: Added 2026-11-09: running the agent locally with its data produces the recorded answers a deployed version must match (reference-answers.json). Candidates checked before this date were not scored on it.
